name: std::codecvt<InternT,ExternT,StateT>::~codecvt
intro: Destructs a std::codecvt facet. This destructor is protected and virtual (due to base class destructor being virtual). An object of type std::codecvt, like most facets, can only be destroyed when the last std::locale object that implements this facet goes out of scope or if a user-defined class is derived from std::codecvt and implements a public destructor.
